name: IDRX
oneLiner: IDRX is PT IDRX Indo Inovasi's centralized rupiah stablecoin, backed 1:1 by IDR fiat reserves and Indonesian government bonds with KYC-gated mint and redeem.
collateral: Indonesian rupiah (IDR) fiat reserves and government bonds held 1:1 by PT IDRX Indo Inovasi; CertiK-audited smart contracts with multisig controls
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption of IDRX for Indonesian rupiah through IDRX platform after KYC verification; native multichain deployment with built-in bridge functions

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: IDRX documents both direct issuer minting on a selected supported chain and an issuer-operated bridge in which a source burn and its transaction hash are submitted to IDRX before the destination wallet receives IDRX. Its supported-chain page lists the exact current Solana mint. Pharos therefore treats the documented route as issuer-native burn/mint rather than a third-party bridge.

Its bridge flow burns IDRX on the source chain, submits the burn transaction hash to IDRX, then sends IDRX to the destination wallet; direct issuer minting is also available for a selected supported chain. At finalized Solana slot 434086281, the exact SPL mint reported 2 decimals, mint authority Bpqui7hhcjfHoxwbkK4dw1GBB86Rt1DHEjQu8Mr7g8Tn, and no freeze authority.

mintAuthority.summary: On Base (primary chain confirmed), IDRX MINTER_ROLE is held by three issuer-controlled Safes (2-of-3, 2-of-8, 2-of-4) plus an ElevatedMinterBurner contract whose owner is an issuer EOA. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is an issuer EOA. The UUPS proxy has no external proxy admin; upgrade authority is DEFAULT_ADMIN. Other chains share the same contract address pattern and were not individually re-verified.

review.evidence: At Base block 47200691: IDRX (ERC1967 UUPS proxy, no external proxy admin) → implementation at 0x36aa37a29378cd3fe12fa67b7e1f0a7558ec8693. MINTER_ROLE held by 3 Safes (2-of-3, 2-of-8, 2-of-4; all without modules) and 1 ElevatedMinterBurner (owned by EOA 0x46d58b...). DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0x5515be... The CertiK-described MPC pattern manifests here as multiple Safe-multisig minters plus an ElevatedMinterBurner. Verified on Base only; other chains use same address pattern. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No credible independent reserve reconciliation was located: IDRX documentation makes generic audit claims but publishes no named reserve attestor, stable cadence, or dated reserve-to-liability report; the downloadable CertiK document is a smart-contract security assessment. No exact prudential stablecoin-issuer match for the issuer was established in OJK's public regulatory materials.
